Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary for June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- High SPF sunscreen (reef-safe recommended)
- Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera or smartphone with waterproof case
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommendations:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Evening attire for the luau
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips
- Medications
- Insect repellent

Don't forget to check weather forecasts before departure!
